title: Parameterized tetrahedron-equation solution from a symmetric-butterfly quantum cluster quiver in the formal q-Weyl algebra for generic q
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) article 113, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2024.113; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The construction lifts the cluster transformations to canonical q-Weyl variables and supplies a parameter-dependent monomial operator satisfying the untwisted tetrahedron relation. A new formal-Laurent quantum-dilogarithm identity requires finiteness of each coefficient and normalization of the central scalar, after which the author conjugates the four operator blocks into the required product equality. These formal-series and operator-realization obligations remain explicit in the bundled proof.
author: Rei Inoue; Atsuo Kuniba; Xiaoyue Sun; Yuji Terashima; Junya Yagi
